note: Deuel County MapNet (1stdistrict.org) lists a County Zoning layer (FeatureServer ID 29), but the service returns 'Service not started' / 'Error performing query operation' (HTTP 500) and the services directory is disabled (403), so no zoning polygons can be queried. County zoning map is only in the 2004 ordinance PDFs; Clear Lake publishes its Official Zoning Map only as a static PDF. No other public zoning service found for Deuel County or Clear Lake.
